subject: Conditional deletion attestation + keystore residency proof request
messages:
From: Amelia Rhodes <amelia.rhodes@clearharbor.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: LegalOps <legal@clearharbor.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: conditional deletion attestation + keystore residency artifacts

Hi Irene / Marissa,

As part of our SOC 2 and vendor SIG review we need a short packet showing how Redwood handles a customer-specific deletion carveout we requested earlier. We do not need full production dumps, but our legal and security teams require: 

- A written attestation describing the steps Redwood will take to execute a targeted deletion for a single tenant (what triggers deletion, how manifests are created, retention windows).
- A keystore residency report (where keys are stored / KMS residency for the tenant key, rotation timestamps) and an example audit entry showing key association.
- A hashed proof-of-delete manifest (sample) and guidance on how our auditors can verify the deletion (hash algorithm, sampling process).
- Any CAIQ/SIG mapping references for the above controls (or an approximate mapping in a spreadsheet).

We appreciate concise artifacts — checklist + 1-2 sample exports — and a pointer to who will accept questions. Can you confirm what you can deliver and an approximate ETA?

Thanks,
Amelia
Amelia Rhodes
Security Program Lead, ClearHarbor Health
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Amelia Rhodes <amelia.rhodes@clearharbor.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: conditional deletion attestation + keystore residency artifacts

Hi Amelia — thanks for the clear list. We're able to provide the artifacts you requested; below is a short plan and proposed timeline. Looping in Ben for the artifact exports and Marissa for SIG/CAIQ mapping.

Plan (high level):
- Attestation: Short memo describing the tenant-scoped delete flow and controls (will include triggers, manifest generation, and ops approvals).
- Keystore residency: We will export a resident-key report scope-limited to metadata (no private key material) and include rotation timestamps and KMS region.
- Proof-of-delete sample: We will provide a redacted hashed-manifest (sha256) and instructions for auditor verification.
- CAIQ/SIG mapping: Marissa will prepare a light mapping spreadsheet linking each requested control to CAIQ/SIG rows.

Deliverables and ETA:
- Draft attestation memo (PDF) — by Wed 2027-06-23 EOD PT
- Keystore residency report (PDF) + sample audit entry — by Wed 2027-06-23 EOD PT
- Hashed proof-of-delete sample (manifest + verification steps) — by Thu 2027-06-24 AM PT
- CAIQ/SIG mapping spreadsheet (xlsx) — by Thu 2027-06-24 EOD PT

Can you confirm the auditor contact for verification and whether you prefer delivery through the BrightAudit portal or a shared Drive folder? If you prefer a short call to walk through the artifacts, we can schedule 30 minutes tomorrow.

Thanks — I'll let Ben and Marissa confirm the technical scope.

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi
Senior Manager, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Amelia Rhodes <amelia.rhodes@clearharbor.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 11:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: conditional deletion attestation + keystore residency artifacts

Irene / team / Amelia — quick technical note on what we'll produce and limitations: 

1) Keystore residency:
- We'll provide a metadata-only export (keystore_residency.pdf) containing: key ID, KMS provider, region, creation + last-rotation timestamps, and the tenant association tag. No private key or PEM material will be shared.
- Residency will show whether the key is customer-managed (Bring Your Own Key) or Redwood-managed; for BYOK we'll include the KMS ARN and residency region.

2) Proof-of-delete manifest (sample):
- When a targeted deletion runs we produce a manifest of removed object ids and sha256 hashes. We'll provide a redacted sample manifest (ids hashed) and the verification procedure (audit will get original hash algorithm and salt details).
- Note: full manifests are considered sensitive for operational reasons; we can provide a sample + deterministic verification steps auditors can run against their exported manifest.

3) Attestation wording (operational):
- We'll state the trigger conditions (tenant request or legal hold expiration), required approvals, and automated steps (manifest generation, deletion job, verification job).
- We'll include a short timeline for our internal retention-to-delete windows and where temporary forensics snapshots may be retained for investigations (only if specifically requested; otherwise not).

4) Artifacts and delivery:
- Attachments we plan to drop into the Drive folder you confirm: clearharbor_SIG_responses.xlsx (SIG mapping draft), keystore_residency.pdf, proof_of_delete_manifest_sample.jsonl (redacted).

If LegalOps needs an affidavit-style signature, we can prepare a concise one-page attestation for signature by our Head of Security with a Redwood letterhead.

Ben
Ben Carter
Principal Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: keystore_residency.pdf (metadata-only), proof_of_delete_manifest_sample.jsonl (redacted sample)
From: Alex Chen <alex@brightaudit.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Amelia Rhodes <amelia.rhodes@clearharbor.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request: conditional deletion attestation + keystore residency artifacts

Thanks for the plan — BrightAudit will accept artifacts either via our portal or a shared Drive link. A couple of clarifications from the auditor side: 

- For proof-of-delete verification we ask for the hash algorithm and a sample verification script (we can run it against the manifest snapshots you provide). SHA-256 is fine; please indicate whether any per-tenant salt is used when hashing identifiers.
- For keystore residency: we want to see the last-rotation event for the tenant key and a signed audit entry showing the association (timestamped event log entry). If you can provide a redacted log line and the event-id, we can match it to rotation metadata.
- CAIQ mapping: please flag which CAIQ rows reference key lifecycle and secure deletion controls. A one-tab mapping that points to the SIG control numbers is preferred.

Portal link (preferred): https://portal.brightaudit.com/ingest/CH-2027-06
If you prefer Drive, please share a folder with limited access to the auditor group.

Regards,
Alex Chen
Senior Auditor, BrightAudit
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Amelia Rhodes <amelia.rhodes@clearharbor.com>, Alex Chen <alex@brightaudit.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 15:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: conditional deletion attestation + keystore residency artifacts

Amelia / Alex — thank you. Summary / next steps: 

- Deliverables we will upload to the BrightAudit portal by EOD Thu 2027-06-24:
  * clearharbor_SIG_responses.xlsx (one-tab CAIQ/SIG mapping)
  * keystore_residency.pdf (metadata-only export showing KMS provider, region, key id, last rotation timestamp)
  * proof_of_delete_manifest_sample.jsonl (redacted sample + verification README with sha256 details and sample verification script)
  * attestation.pdf (one-page signed attestation optionally executed by Head of Security)

- Action items:
  * Ben: generate keystore_residency.pdf and redacted sample manifest (ETA: Wed 6/23 EOD PT).
  * Marissa: finalize CAIQ/SIG mapping (ETA: Thu 6/24 EOD PT).
  * Irene: prepare attestation and upload all artifacts to BrightAudit (ETA: Thu 6/24 EOD PT).

Amelia — please confirm the auditor group email for Drive access if you prefer that route; otherwise we'll push to the BrightAudit portal link Alex provided. Also confirm whether LegalOps wants the signed attestation or whether a PDF with our standard letterhead suffices for now.

Thanks everyone — happy to hop on a 30-minute call if you prefer a walkthrough after artifacts are uploaded.

Best,
Irene
Senior Manager, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
